Name: Pikmin Junimos
Author: MangusuPixel
Description:
[size=5]Details[/size]
[list]
[*]Includes 1 onion home, 3 growth stages (leaf, bud, flower), 9 variants, 27 unique combinations, 81 animations and 432 frames.
[*]Includes configuration file (compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]) to resize pikmin and toggle the Onion.
[*]Works on both community center and harvester Junimos.
[*]No dependency other than SMAPI.
[*]Uses Harmony to patch the rendering calls. The source code is available on [url=https://github.com/MangusuPixel/PikminJunimos]GitHub[/url]﻿.
[*]The onion isn't compatible with AT, but you can disable it in the settings to use AT-compatible Junimo huts.
[/list]
